notes: All three operations work through the namespace API. Caveats: (a) invalidated edges are NOT excluded from search unless the caller passes an expired_at IS NULL filter (and valid-time filters for as_of); (b) in-place edit loses the original text, keeps provenance, and records nothing about who/why; (c) delete leaves the edge uuid inside EpisodicNode.entity_edges. DECISION (ADR-018, DEC-04): corrections are authoritative in a Postgres fact-status projection (rejected/disputed/superseded/deleted) that every read path joins/filters on; the graph edge is updated best-effort (expired_at + invalid_at, or delete) and every graph search carries the expired_at filter. Never rely on in-place edits as the audit trail.
